Practical Considerations
Memory & Complexity
•fAD has a small memory footprint — carry derivative 
alongside the computation
•rAD must remember all intermediate results 
(GPT-3: 175 billion parameters Float16 ~350 GB), 
some mitigated with re-computation (Gradient-
checkpointing) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-3
https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.10631
